hypothesis.explanation: Inserting 4 elements into a full 2-element inline buffer shifts existing data far past the allocation, causing an out-of-bounds write.
TelemetryCounter uses Cell<usize> with an unsafe Sync impl, so concurrent increment from two threads performs unsynchronized non-atomic read-modify-writes on the same location.
Advancing cursor beyond length then reading with large offset drives idx past backing storage toward unchecked access.
